name: eco
description: Eco — an intelligent personal finance ecosystem

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @eco/shared && npm run build -w @eco/core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @eco/api && npm run build -w @eco/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @eco/api" "npm run dev -w @eco/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @eco/core && npm run test -w @eco/api
